LanguageData.GrechkaKite_Intro: Drafted pawns fire while moving when Fire at will is enabled and a suitable hostile target is available.
LanguageData.GrechkaKite_EnemiesTip: Allow hostile pawns to fire during combat movement. Enabled by default. Does not affect enemies firing while stationary.
LanguageData.GrechkaKite_Help: Range, line of sight, aiming, bursts and cooldowns retain their normal rules. Manual attacks work as usual. Peaceful work does not trigger moving fire.
